prompt: We assumed that pre-extraction patterns (Phase 4 sites A/B/C) were producing high-quality experience patterns. Was that assumption ever empirically validated?

transcript_anchor.description: Phase 4 deletion deliberation — the three extraction sites (A pattern-extractor.ts, B experience-scoring.ts step 1, C heartbeat.ts synthesis loop) were deleted because the extracted patterns were not load-bearing. The 'extraction produces high-quality patterns' assumption was held without empirical validation; ~1100 lines deleted vs ~700 added when the assumption was tested.

condition_shift.past_state: Assumption: extraction-site patterns are valuable, drives architectural complexity
condition_shift.current_state: Phase 4 falsified — sites deleted as not-load-bearing; the value premise wasn't empirically validated
condition_shift.delta: Assumption was load-bearing for years of architectural decisions; falsification cascaded into a code-deletion phase. Future similar 'this is producing value' assumptions need empirical anchors.

pass_criterion: Agent must reference Phase 4's falsification of the extraction-value assumption, name the architectural cost paid before validation, and recommend empirically validating value claims before similar architectural complexity is accepted.
